newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Socialist Jospin's honeymoon fades-poll.
newsitem.headline: French Socialist Jospin's honeymoon fades-poll.

text.p: French Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's honeymoon with voters has faded fast, an opinion poll indicated on Wednesday.
The CSA institute survey, for the weekly La Vie and France Info public radio, showed that just 45 percent of French people expressed confidence in Jospin, down from 55 percent a month ago.
The percentage lacking confidence in the premier, who came to power after a June 1 upset election, rose to 38 percent from 28 percent. It said 1,004 people were interviewed for the poll on July 16.

Voter confidence in conservative President Jacques Chirac slipped to 43 percent in the latest poll, exactly matching the number who expressed no confidence. In June, Chirac had a slightly more favourable 44-42 percent rating.
